units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:4">Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 4</cite> <he>צורה</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 28:12">Targ. Ez. XXVIII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69b:11">B. Mets. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לצור בה צ׳ דצבו וכ׳</he> to put a painting on (as a sign), which people like, and by which trade is increased.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 54a:7">B. Bath. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>רב לא קני</he> … <he>אלא בצ׳</he> Rab took symbolical possession of the garden of the school-house merely by drawing a figure.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 45b:4">B. Mets. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>דעתיה אצ׳</he> his mind is on the figure (the legend on the coin which determines its value), <he>וצ׳ עבידא דבטלה</he> and the legend is liable to abrogation.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:25">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ דשמעתא</he> the form (general outlines) of the subject to be discussed; a. e.
